Which hostname to allowlist

Find the gateway you connect to in the globally distributed SaaS gateway docs. nat_ips on that hostname is the full allowlist, including the documented fallback region.

gateway.truefoundry.aiEvery regional gateway

When addresses change

A new address is announced in a GitHub Release and starts carrying traffic 15 days later. Allowlist it during those 15 days. When an address is removed, drop it after that release. Pin a version from the release assets instead of these always-latest files.

Plain text files list one CIDR per line. JSON is the same list grouped by hostname.
